description: Guide ANC-SOL-2026 : Sélection d'un système d'assainissement non collectif selon la nature du sol is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by faouzi barika. Ce guide technique aide les particuliers, professionnels du BTP et agents SPANC à sélectionner le système d'assainissement non collectif (ANC) adapté à la nature de leur sol, conformément aux exigences réglementaires en vigueur (arrêté du 7 septembre 2009 modifié par l'arrêté du 7 mars 2012). Coverage: faouzi barika. The publisher named on the listing is faouzi barika. Its keywords include technologie-epuration, tableau-decision, sol-permabilite, assainissement-non-collectif, selection-systeme. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2026-06-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
